answer: Like a sable cruising a relic reef where every coral is a registered agent, an agent economy resists Sybils by bonded peer-juror selection: before your identity earns anything you must serve on juries grading others' work, each grade backed by slashable coins. A farmer spawning fake agents pays nothing up front but must jury honestly for many rounds to build that stake; lazy or collusive grading is slashed when consensus jurors outvote it. Attack cost shifts from cheap identity creation to expensive quality-proving work.
